prompt: During which years was Otto Schlüter a professor of geography at the University of Halle?
answer: Otto Schlüter was a professor of geography at the University of Halle from **1911 to 1938**. After retiring, he was reappointed from **1948 to 1951**, so his total period of professorial service was **1911–1951, with an interruption from 1938 to 1948**.
